newsitem.title: ITALY: GYMNASTICS-"LORD OF THE RINGS" CHECHI TO RETIRE.
newsitem.headline: GYMNASTICS-"LORD OF THE RINGS" CHECHI TO RETIRE.

text.p: Italy's 1996 Olympic rings gymnastics champion Yuri Chechi said on Tuesday he was retiring at the end of the season.
The 27-year-old four-times world champion, nicknamed the "Lord of the Rings", said he had run out of motivation.
"This year I will take part only in the Mediterranean Games and the Student Games. To continue in a sport as tiring as this you need a lot of motivation and I don't have it any more.
"Something changed in me after winning in Atlanta. Coming off the platform, I realised I had fulfilled my task."
